outcome: reproductive health service utilization (family planning, prenatal care, facility-based delivery, home delivery by competent birth staff, cesarean section, postnatal care, neonatal care)
use of free reproductive health services
cohort: The study included mothers attending targeted health facilities in the Lahj governorate (which supports a voucher program) and the Abyan governorate (which does not) in Yemen.
finding: The Safe Motherhood and Family Planning Voucher Program significantly improved mothers' satisfaction, access, and utilization of all reproductive health services, including prenatal, natal, postnatal, and neonatal care, compared to a non-voucher program.
mod_finding: Mothers using vouchers in the Lahj governorate more frequently utilized facility-based delivery, home delivery by competent birth staff, and cesarean sections compared to mothers in the Abyan governorate.
